text: Get started with just one line of code
quote: Better yet - it only takes one line of code to get started.

text: View metrics like request count, token usage, and cost
quote: View metrics such as the number of requests, tokens, and the cost it takes to run your application.

text: See insights on requests and errors
quote: Gain insight on requests and errors.

text: Serve cached responses instead of calling the provider, for speed and cost savings
quote: Serve requests directly from Cloudflare's cache instead of the original model provider for faster requests and cost savings.

text: Rate limiting controls traffic to prevent expensive bills and abuse
quote: Rate limiting controls the traffic that reaches your application, which prevents expensive bills and suspicious activity.

text: Choose fixed or sliding window rate limiting technique
quote: You can also select if you would like a **fixed** or **sliding** rate limiting technique.

text: Improve resilience with request retries and model fallbacks on error
quote: Improve resilience by defining request retry and model fallbacks in case of an error.

text: Automatically falls back to another provider (e.g. OpenAI) if the first request fails
quote:
Sends a request to Workers AI Inference API.
2. If that request fails, proceeds to OpenAI.

text: Simplifies switching between different models without major code changes
quote: This feature simplifies the integration process, allowing for seamless switching between different models without significant code modifications.

text: Supports many providers: Workers AI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Replicate, and more
quote: Workers AI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Replicate, and more work with AI Gateway.

text: Dynamic routing lets you build request flows via visual interface or JSON config
quote: Dynamic routing enables you to create request routing flows through a **visual interface** or a **JSON-based configuration**.

text: Route different user segments (e.g. paid vs free) to different models
quote: Directing different segments (paid/not-paid user) to different models

text: Restrict each user/project/team with budget and rate limits
quote: Restricting each user/project/team with budget/rate limits

text: Override default cache behavior per-request using HTTP headers
quote: AI Gateway allows you to override default cache behaviors on a per-request basis using specific HTTP headers.

text: Can log usage metrics/metadata without storing sensitive prompt or completion content
quote: This is useful when you want to maintain visibility into usage metrics and request metadata without persisting sensitive prompt or completion data.

text: Passes through provider inference pricing with no markup
quote: Inference pricing from providers is passed through with no markup — you pay the same per-token rates as you would directly with the provider.

text: Response header indicates which step/model successfully processed a fallback request
quote: the response header `cf-aig-step` indicates which model successfully processed the request by returning the step number.

text: Offers an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint for multi-provider integration via one URL
quote: Cloudflare's AI Gateway offers an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint, enabling integration with multiple AI providers using a single URL.

text: Define rate limits as number of requests per time window
quote: You can define rate limits as the number of requests that get sent in a specific time frame. For example, you can limit your application to 100 requests per 60 seconds.

text: Triggers fallback provider on request errors or timeouts
quote: Cloudflare can trigger your fallback provider in response to request errors or predetermined request timeouts.

text: Switch providers by changing model and apiKey parameters
quote: Switch providers by changing the \`model\` and \`apiKey\` parameters.

text: Connect to AI providers using their native API formats through the gateway
quote: Connect to AI providers using their native API formats through AI Gateway.

text: Supports A/B testing and gradual rollouts accessible to technical and non-technical users
quote: A/B and gradual rollouts while making it accessible to both developers and non-technical team members.

text: Header lets you bypass default logging setting per request
quote: The \`cf-aig-collect-log\` header allows you to bypass the default log setting for the gateway.

text: Manage all provider costs under one bill with a single API for every provider
quote: Manage all your costs with one simple bill and access every provider through a single API.

text: Protects AI applications from leaking or sending sensitive information
quote: Protect your AI applications from leaking or sending sensitive information.

text: Rich logging and metrics enable comprehensive monitoring and alerting
quote: Create comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems using AI Gateway's rich logging and metrics data.

text: API method to send feedback, score, and metadata for a specific log entry
quote: The patchLog method allows you to send feedback, score, and metadata for a specific log ID.

text: Control application scaling by limiting the number of requests it receives
quote: Control how your application scales by limiting the number of requests your application receives.

text: Response header shows whether a response was served from cache (HIT/MISS)
quote: To check whether a response comes from cache or not, **cf-aig-cache-status** will be designated as `HIT` or `MISS`.

text: Compose routing flows that evaluate conditions, enforce quotas, and choose models with fallbacks, versioned without code changes
quote: you compose a small flow that evaluates conditions, enforces quotas, and chooses models with fallbacks. You can iterate without touching application code—publish a new route version and you’re done.

text: Specify model or provider fallbacks on the Universal endpoint for reliability
quote: Specify model or provider fallbacks with your Universal endpoint to handle request failures and ensure reliability.

text: Dashboard shows detailed per-request logs: prompt, response, provider, timestamp, status, tokens, cost, duration, user agent
quote: Your AI Gateway dashboard shows logs of individual requests, including the user prompt, model response, provider, timestamp, request status, token usage, cost, duration, and the user agent of the client that made the request.

text: Header controls whether raw request/response payloads are stored per request
quote: The `cf-aig-collect-log-payload` header allows you to control whether the raw request and response bodies (payloads) are stored for a given request.

text: Configure a named gateway via a simple config object/ID
quote: gateway: {      id: "my-gateway",    },
